description: Urban heavy rail journeys in 2024–2025. Circle area encodes journeys; Australian Bureau of Statistics Greater Capital City Statistical Area representative points locate cities, not trip origins.
Separate Yearbook 2025 city estimates; five overlaid indexed series share a 2018–2019 baseline. City selection retains context. Nearest-year tooltips compare all cities on the same index.
Arithmetic bridge using only the same Yearbook series as C02. Floating intervals add each city’s signed contribution to the combined total.

Two simultaneous 100-square grids compare metropolitan and V/Line train journeys. Each square is approximately one percentage point; exact regional shares are labelled. Both panels form one waffle comparison.

Department of Transport and Planning monthly totals from two complete financial years. Endpoints only; intervening changes are not shown. Method for estimating train transaction rates changed in January 2021.

Reported non-urban journeys by state and service, 2024–2025. Rectangle area is proportional to journeys. All five services have visible names and exact values; small-service labels provide larger tooltip targets. The two largest services account for 96.3% of the reported total.

Ratio of sums for stations matched by stable identifier and unchanged local government area, using original 2025 Australian Bureau of Statistics polygons. Colour measures recovery, not residents’ travel. Grey means no eligible matched stations.

Full equal-area squares in Australian equal-area coordinate system (reference number 3577), including all 222 current stations. Sum of cell entries equals the release total. Colour domain stays fixed across grid sizes; aggregation changes with cell size.
Five largest positive and five largest negative absolute changes among 220 matched station identifiers. Other 210 stations omitted from this selected-extremes view.
Twelve largest annual-entry stations passing profile screens. Unequal-duration bands show shares of the published five-band sum, not an hourly arrival rate.
Frequency distribution in 20-point intervals; baseline threshold is selectable. All eligible extremes retained; each station counts once.

Same 191 eligible stations each year. Ratio is average of Saturday and Sunday daily entries divided by weekday daily entries. Boxes show middle half; line is median; whiskers 1.5 interquartile range (the width of the middle half of values); points are outliers. Stations have equal weight.
